items.preview: Community Monument Sign Cost — Jacksonville Guide — what it costs, what drives price, and when to order
items.seo_title: Community Monument Sign Cost — Jacksonville Guide
items.meta_description: What a community entrance monument sign costs in Jacksonville, what drives the price, and when to order — from a local sign fabricator.

faq.q: How much is a monument sign for a new community?
faq.a: In the Jacksonville area, most community entrance monuments cost $8,000–$35,000+ installed, with a typical masonry-and-dimensional-letter monument around $12,000–$20,000.

faq.q: How long does it take to get a community monument sign?
faq.a: Plan on 8–12 weeks: HOA/architectural review, county permitting and wind-load engineering, fabrication, and installation. Order the day you break ground.

faq.q: Do I need a permit for a monument sign in Jacksonville?
faq.a: Yes. Duval, Clay, and St. Johns each have sign codes and Florida requires wind-load engineering. A local fabricator handles the permit and engineering as part of the project.

items.body_md:
## How much does a community entrance monument sign cost in Jacksonville?

Most community entrance monument signs in the Jacksonville area run **$8,000–$35,000+ installed**, depending on size, materials, lighting, and permitting. A single-face masonry monument with dimensional lettering typically lands in the **$12,000–$20,000** range; larger dual-monument entrances with backlighting and landscaping coordination go higher.

### What drives the price
- **Size & structure** — brick/stone or precast vs. an aluminum-and-composite build.
- **Lettering** — flat-cut acrylic vs. dimensional metal vs. push-through illuminated.
- **Lighting** — non-illuminated, ground-lit, or internally illuminated (adds transformers + electrical).
- **Permitting & engineering** — Clay, St. Johns, and Duval each have their own sign codes; wind-load engineering is required in Florida.
- **Site work** — footings, grading, and irrigation/landscape coordination at the entrance.

### When to order
Start the signage conversation the day you break ground. Between HOA/architectural review, county permitting, and fabrication, a community monument realistically needs **8–12 weeks** before it's installed — and models open faster than most builders expect.

Brand 9 Signs designs, fabricates, permits, and installs community entrance monuments across Jacksonville, Clay, and St. Johns — one team from concept to install.
